map.某设备原值 100 万元、残值 10 万元、年限 5 年，年折旧率=2/5=40: An asset has a cost of 100 (10k CNY), salvage value of 10 (10k CNY) and useful life of 5 years, so the annual depreciation rate = 2/5 = 40%. Year 1 depreciation = 100×40% = 40 (10k CNY), net book value 60 (10k CNY); Year 2 depreciation = 60×40% = 24 (10k CNY), net book value 36 (10k CNY); the final two years switch to the straight-line method to spread the remaining book value less salvage value.
map.双倍余额递减法最后两年怎么处理？: How are the last two years handled under the double declining balance method?
map.为在残值处停提，通常在折旧年限到期前两年内，将剩余账面净值减去残值后平均摊销（即: To stop depreciating at the salvage value, the remaining net book value less salvage value is usually amortised evenly over the last two years of the asset's life (i.e. switching to the straight-line method).
map.为什么前期不扣减残值？: Why is the salvage value not deducted in the early years?
map.双倍余额递减法以固定率乘账面净值，若早期扣残值会降低折旧基数；残值通过最后两年直: The double declining balance method multiplies a fixed rate by the net book value; deducting salvage value early would lower the depreciation base. The salvage value is naturally reflected through the straight-line method in the last two years, ensuring the ending net book value equals the salvage value.
map.双倍余额递减折旧：年折旧率 = 2 ÷ 使用年限 n；第 k 年折旧 = 期初账: Double-declining balance depreciation: annual depreciation rate = 2 ÷ useful life n; year k depreciation = opening book value × (2÷n), charged against the declining book value each year; in the final year (k = n), or when charging would push book value below the residual value, depreciation is closed out as book value − residual value (residual-value fallback) so the closing book value is never below the residual value. Validation: useful life must be positive, and the year number must be an integer between 1 and 1000, otherwise an error is reported. Rule: no fixed grading; the output gives the year-y depreciation, closing book value and accumulated depreciation (CNY), with heavier depreciation early and declining each year.
map.双倍余额递减折旧：年折旧率 = 2 ÷ 使用年限 n。n≥2 时，前 n−2 年: Double-declining balance depreciation: annual rate = 2 ÷ useful life n. For n≥2, the first n−2 years use opening net book value × (2÷n), and the final two years (years n−1 and n) switch to straight-line, spreading the remaining depreciable amount evenly down to the salvage value; for n=1 the asset is depreciated to salvage value in one year. If net book value after any year falls below salvage value, it is floored at salvage value. Validation: cost>0, salvage value between 0 and cost, useful life a positive integer, and the year an integer from 1–n. Outputs the year-y depreciation, ending book value and accumulated depreciation; early years are larger and decline, and ending book value equals salvage value.
map.前 n−2 年：期初账面值 × 2/n；最后两年：剩余可折旧额 ÷ 2。: First n−2 years: opening book value × 2/n; final two years: remaining depreciable amount ÷ 2.
map.某设备原值 100 万元、残值 10 万元、年限 5 年，年折旧率=2/5=40: An asset costs 1,000,000 CNY with salvage value 100,000 CNY and a 5-year life; the annual rate is 2/5 = 40%. Year 1 depreciation = 400,000 CNY, book value 600,000 CNY; year 2 = 240,000 CNY, book value 360,000 CNY; year 3 = 144,000 CNY, book value 216,000 CNY; the final two years (4–5) switch to straight-line, each = (216,000−100,000)/2 = 58,000 CNY, ending at salvage value 100,000 CNY.
map.前 n−2 年按双倍余额递减，最后两年（第 n−1、n 年）改为直线法，把剩余可: The first n−2 years use double-declining balance, and the final two years (n−1 and n) switch to straight-line, spreading the remaining depreciable amount to salvage value; for n=1 the asset is depreciated to salvage value in one year.
map.n=1 时没有“最后两年”，第 1 年直接折旧到残值，折旧额=原值−残值，期末账: With n=1 there are no "final two years"; year 1 depreciates directly to salvage value, depreciation = cost − salvage, and ending book value equals salvage value.
